_comment: Own ideas 200 from the master plan, batch 3. Read by scripts/core/EchoTower.gd (1101, 1102), MasterRifts.gd (1104), MasterTour.gd (1105), RandomRift.gd (1107, 1108), HallTimes.gd (1109), FinalExam.gd (1110), WeeklyGiant.gd (1118) and Released.gd (1136, 1137).

echo_tower.warden_line: Floor %d: the light folds into a shape you know. %s, or what is left of them.
echo_tower.top_line: Floor 100. The lamp is cold, the echoes are quiet, and the view is exactly as disappointing as everyone said.

master_rifts.name: Master Rift: %s
master_rifts.intro: This Rift remembers losing to you. It has been practising.
master_rifts.win_line: The hall goes quiet. Somewhere a Warden pretends not to have watched.

master_tour.intro: Twelve Wardens, one after another, no healing. Your Spirlings signed nothing. You signed for them.
master_tour.step_line: Warden %d of %d is waiting. Your team is still bleeding from the last one.
master_tour.clear_line: All twelve, back to back. The Wardens agree to never speak of it. Especially to you.

random_rift.intro: Today's Rift: %s, rule %s. Nobody built it. That is what worries people.
random_rift.rental_ask: Fight with your own team or with three rented Spirlings? The rentals are clean. Mostly.

final_exam.name: Examiner Hollis
final_exam.locked: Examiner Hollis: Twelve Wardens beaten twice, then we talk. I do not grade half a map.
intro: Examiner Hollis: The guild sent me. The guild sends me when it wants someone to fail politely.
Examiner Hollis: Last exam of the game. Draw the map with your Spirlings. I will be the eraser.
final_exam.win_line: Examiner Hollis: Passed. I will tell the guild it was close. It was not. Lying is part of the job.
final_exam.done_line: Examiner Hollis: You passed. Stop coming back, people think I failed you.

weekly_giant.intro: This week's giant: %s. Everyone in Veydal gets a swing at it. Best this week: %d%%.

letter: A letter, scratched with a claw: %s made it home to %s.
It says it does not blame you. It says that twice, which is how you know it does.
letter_wild: A letter, scratched with a claw: %s found some tall grass and a quiet life.
It thanks you for the battles. It does not mention the box.
released.sighting: You think you see %s at the edge of the path. It looks fine. It does not look back.
